changes: If preparing Keeta stops without a user stop, the comparison still reads the HungerStation total, which is only read and never edited.
The Keeta row shows that it stopped, and the final message names both outcomes.
The message for an unverified Keeta options page names the product.
Everything from 1.3.21 is kept, including up to four meals with options.

physical.phoneTrialOf1_3_21: plain items stopped at an unverified Keeta options page before any add; no HungerStation total was shown

limitations: Keeta items whose product sheet has options or additions are added only for the two verified ALBAIK items; other such items still stop before any add.
Multiple configured meals are still not run on a phone.
Not supported: a plain item in the same cart as a meal with options, two meals with the same name, quantity above one, a Keeta cart that already holds only some of the meals, and optional additions.
If the Keeta cart drawer scrolls with three or four meals, the comparison stops with a message; this has not been tried.
Verified on KFC only in earlier releases; other restaurants are not proven.
privacy: No account data, addresses, tokens, private captures or signing material included.
